item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 18
item.description:
11 development commits

Combat Audio

  • Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.

Farming & UI

  • Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.

Vehicle & Animal Transport

  • Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 16
item.description:
74 development commits

Combat & Tools

  • Attached grenades now appear instantly when the attach_reveal animation triggers, removing previous delays where grenades could be hidden or appear late.

Building & World

  • A new invisible, invulnerable but collidable building tier was added, letting players block off spaces or create floating displays that still interact with items and wallpaper.
  • Garage doors now have more granular collider movement and updated prefabs, improving precision, LODs, and interaction smoothness.

Seasonal Events

  • Scarecrows now function correctly for the Halloween 2026 update, fixing a critical error that previously broke them.

Critters & AI

  • Job assignment bugs for crabs and jellyfish have been resolved, ensuring they behave as intended.
  • Animals can now attack players standing next to vehicles, fixing a previous immunity issue.

Livestock Interaction

  • Leading remains the default action before petting livestock, making interaction order more consistent.

Server Stability

  • Joining clients no longer reset server convars or gamemode settings, preserving custom configurations during C+S sessions.

Bug Fixes

  • Wounded head orientation now displays correctly and animation pooling glitches during mid‑turns are resolved.
  • Live tattoo painting now uses separate visibility for new ink, preventing unwanted fading of fresh tattoos.
